name: Netorare Wife Misumi - Lustful Awakening
source:
Shoma and his wife Misumi have recently moved into their new home. In the same building also lives the cheerful and lively Chiyo, Shoma's cousin, with whom he grew up.
He does a desk job and his life goes on as usual, until one day, coming back from home, he notices a suspicious man. What will become of Shoma and his wife Misumi? 

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/azienda]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
Shoma与妻子美澄最近搬进了新家。同一栋楼里，还住着活泼开朗的Chiyo，她与Shoma是堂表亲，两人从小一起长大。
Shoma从事文职工作，生活一如往常。直到某天回家时，他注意到了一个可疑的男人。Shoma与妻子美澄的未来，将会如何发展？
